final: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), global_total AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_clients FROM district_counts) SELECT dc.region, AVG(dc.client_count) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(1.0 * dc.client_count / gt.total_clients) AS avg_share_of_all_clients FROM district_counts AS dc CROSS JOIN global_total AS gt GROUP BY dc.region
